PC data (level_pig/tricks.xml): babybottle_nitro 20, pigout 10, cookiebox_hot 15 — the video reading had the milk's 10 and the pig's 20 the other way round; the milk keeps the mobile 20, the pig pays 10. PC anger (game.exe, docs/PC_ROUTINES.md "The anger and the bonus"): PCAngryTime on the Rottweiler is level_pig/level.xml's angrytime=192 (1/12 s ticks: the level state ticks 12 times a second, as the HUD clock shows) — the rage current a trick without its own value is set to and the mercury's full scale; PCAngryTime on an item is its tricks.xml angrytime (Ground 252, PigMilk 240); the profile holds the current 60 ticks, counts it down one per tick and pays +3 for a trick fired while it is above zero (pcprofile.s1_rage_*).
